title: CIA-UAP-018, Report of Unusual Flying Object Sightings and Attendant Scientific Activity
doc_notes: This document is a CIA intelligence report containing a translation of a letter from a Hungarian citizen describing UFO sightings in Budapest in November 1955, featuring heavy redactions.

incidents.summary: Multiple unidentified flying objects reported over Budapest, Hungary, described as fast-moving flyers traveling at 12,000 km/h.
incidents.quote: these amazing fliers moved at a speed of 12,000 kilometers per hour
